chunks: And in another narration, al-Sadiq عليه السلام said:
Eat whatever the dog has eaten from, even if it has eaten two-thirds of it. Eat whatever the dog has eaten, even if nothing remains of it except a single piece.
ai.seo_question: Is hunted game still halal if the dog has eaten from most of it?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام gives a legal ruling concerning hunted game that a dog has eaten from. It indicates the permissibility of eating from such prey even if the dog consumed most of it and only a small portion remains.
